verdict.rationale: Qodo has no documented data-export feature, but some of its data is portable. Configuration can be managed as code in a `.pr_agent.toml` file stored in your own repositories. Reviews surface as native labels and tags inside your Git provider. The MCP and CLI let you programmatically retrieve findings and rules. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export of findings history, rules and governance data in open formats, an export or offboarding guide, a public API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404), and independent confirmation that users can fully leave with their data.
